name: A Spinster's Guide to Regency Romance
source:
After the death of her father, spinster-in-training Isabella Sinclair discovers she must make a match or lose her inheritance to her best friend's brother, Thomas Blackwood. She soon realizes she'd rather marry than see him win! 

[From [url=https://pixelpoxet.itch.io/a-spinsters-guide-to-regency-romance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
父亲去世后，未婚老处女伊莎贝拉·辛克莱发现她必须与她最好朋友的弟弟托马斯·布莱克伍德进行匹配，否则就会失去继承权。她很快意识到她宁愿结婚也不愿看到他获胜！

[来自[url=https://pixelpoxet.itch.io/a-spinsters-guide-to-regency-romance]itch.io[/url]]
